about.title: More than 9 years turning designs into product.
paragraphs: I'm a Front-End Engineer born in Venezuela and based in Santiago, Chile. I specialize in React, Next.js and TypeScript, with a strong focus on UI architecture, performance and maintainable code.

I've shipped the full in-store pickup flow for Cencosud, worked on international products like SoundExchange, Whitepages and Campomar, built internal UI libraries published to AWS CodeArtifact, and migrated legacy front-ends to React + Redux.

specs.tail: Field-tested with Scrum, Kanban, Material-UI, SASS and Bootstrap.

jobs.description: Athenaworks (SoundExchange, Whitepages) and Aurica, Chile's leading precious-metals broker.
Full Stack for Catalytic and Rundeck, with a frontend focus, plus 24/7 on-call rotations for Catalytic ensuring product stability in production.
Financial platforms with React, Next.js and TypeScript. Built an internal UI library and optimized CI/CD pipelines on AWS.
Led front-end on several e-commerce initiatives. Migrated legacy components to React + Redux, ~35% faster.
Reusable components with React and Material-UI, REST API integration.
Financial apps with React, Redux and Apollo GraphQL, with a focus on responsive, accessible UI.
Responsive interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and Bootstrap.
Led development of MasterHelp.net and defined its front-end architecture.
